Input boundary implemented on sinkhorn-input-boundary (worktree, shared HEAD stayed main).

Design (chief acceptance): refuse all-+Inf row/column when target mass > 0, so "no admissible partner" cannot publish as an all-zero plan. +Inf cell stays as a forbidden edge (exact 0.0). NaN/-Inf cost and non-finite or negative marginals refuse via existing InvalidConfig.

Suite only, all three platforms:
  alignJVM/JS/Native testOnly SinkhornSuite: 16/16 each, GATE_EXIT=0
  compileAll + scalafmtCheckAll still to run before a candidate.
